test_command_note: Every declared test file is a standalone runnable Python unittest module executed from the project root; each bootstraps sys.path (repository root and ops/harness) through a100c/tests/_bootstrap.py, because the host driver has no pytest (F014).

case binding; meta-tier specialization identity (pointer dtypes, scalar classes honoring do_not_specialize, constexprs incl. deterministic autotune config); constexpr folding; dead-branch elimination
source type rules: literal typing, promotion/unification, result types, value conversion distinct from bitcast, zero-dim values
rank/extent inference with broadcast extents distinguished from real extents; declared alignment rules; disagreement is a diagnostic

case-layer grid extraction with provenance over bundle-visible quantities (scalar args, view extents, constexprs); runtime grid-evaluation plan; compile-time equality self-check; refusal outside the extractable domain

shared analysis owner: dominance, liveness, loop structure, memory effects, with a declared invalidation contract
common subexpression elimination under availability and effect/alias proofs
dead code elimination preserving observable stores, atomics, synchronization and stage effects
constant folding and propagation under source width, signedness, overflow, rounding and path conditions
copy propagation under dominance, control-flow joins, value identity and pointer semantics

loop-invariant code motion under invariance, effects, aliasing, masks and zero-trip safety

MIR-CFG loop analysis (natural loops, dominators, per-point region state) and the mir-optimize passes: loop-invariant motion under speculation and region-consistency legality, affine-induction strength reduction, counted-loop predicate resolution, region-consistent vsetvli hoisting
work partition for 1/2/4/8 workers: strided program-instance ranges (default), contiguous output-tile chunks when repartitioning is legal, tails and coverage
stage/synchronization/merge planning for cross-worker dependencies; workspace ownership, visibility and lifetime
dot tiling to IME tiles (8x16x8 INT8, 8x8x8 FP16), packing decisions, zero-padded staging for tails, vector-file-budget-bounded chunking with an ordinary path retained
RVV vectorization: vsetvli regions, exact vl, masked tails, wide-access selection from proven contiguity/alignment
IME matrix lowering: tile mapping (vs1 row-major A, vs2 column-major B), accumulation typing, register grouping constraints, MCPM-controlled format, BF16 gap handling via the vector FP32 path
scalar/int64/bool lowering with declared wrap semantics, atomics with mask and signedness, debug_barrier ordering, control flow to MIR branches
whole-tree i64 address materialization with broadcast extents applied before accumulation; independent index-computation check
declared instruction repertoire as data (RVV, IME smt.* with constraints and recorded absences, scalar RV64); adding an operation is a table edit
legalisation: expressible-but-illegal MIR forms rewritten to legal sequences; guarantees post-state is inside the declared repertoire
one generic constraint-checked matcher over the repertoire table; no entry means a located refusal
GPR and vector-register allocation from real liveness over the real CFG; 32x128B vector budget; IME group parity; compiler-owned spill/split with stack slots
mechanical program-level assembly emission (entry, bundle binding, native grid evaluation, worker range loops, stages, constants, workspace); traceable to selected MIR ops
pipeline orchestration and the artifact cache keyed by every bound dependency (specialization identity, compiler revision, target model, options, argument-layout version)
A100_COMPILER_FACTORY entry: compile_case(case) -> ExecutableArtifact per the a100_support/native_device.py protocol

precompiled native C runtime: process main (--bundle/--threads/--repeats), persistent pthread pool (1/2/4/8), stage barriers and C11 atomics, workspace allocation, a100-native-io/v1 bundle reader with relocation patch/restore and input snapshot/restore for repeats; built by the declared cross toolchain only
native build orchestration: cross as/ld, runtime compilation and linking into the standalone ELF64 RISC-V executable

compile/run/full-scan driver: corpus enumeration via the corpus harness, compile-once-per-identity scheduling, staging/execution/comparison via the native device protocol, input-regression/v1 manifest builder and report writer
generality check: nothing below the frontend branches on operator/kernel/benchmark names; --witness injects a name branch into a scratch copy and must be caught (witness exits nonzero)

declared test tree: standalone runnable unittest modules (one per stage/IR/check), bootstrapping sys.path via a100c/tests/_bootstrap.py

ir_levels.name: TIR
properties: typed block-tensor dataflow; element width and signedness carried as separate type components
value conversion and bit-level reinterpretation are distinct operations and never fold into each other
mask semantics with a per-operation declared disabled-position default (load other / store none / atomic none)
shapes with per-axis extents and broadcast extents distinguished from real extents
reductions carry operation, axes, keep_dims, per-op-and-dtype identity and index tie-break
dot carries operand dtypes, accumulation type, out_dtype and the ieee/tolerance numeric class
index arithmetic typed with declared wrap semantics; addresses formed in i64
structured control flow with explicit join parameters for loop-carried values
RNG ops (philox family) are bit-exact semantic operations

ir_levels.name: MIR
properties: virtual-register dataflow over RVV/IME/scalar operations with an explicit CFG (blocks, branches, block parameters as joins)
vsetvli regions carrying SEW/LMUL/vl and tail policy; region consistency is a verifier invariant
masked vector memory operations with inactive-position semantics (no access, declared default)
IME tile operations carrying the sourced operand contract: LMUL=1, vs1 row-major A, vs2 column-major B, vd even-numbered when MUL_C=2, no destination/source overlap, family operand format
worker partition structure: per-worker entry, range loops, stage barriers, merge operations, workspace addresses with ownership
address materialization in i64 as whole trees
spill slots in the frame, restored before use, storage not reused while live

passes.name: cse
passes.profitability: always profitable when legality holds; memory reuse requires an effect/alias proof

passes.name: dce
passes.profitability: always profitable when legality holds; observable stores, atomics, synchronization and stage effects are preserved

passes.name: const-fold-propagate
passes.profitability: always profitable when legality holds; source width, signedness, overflow, rounding and path conditions survive

passes.name: copy-propagate
passes.profitability: always profitable when legality holds; dominance, joins, value identity and pointer semantics survive

passes.name: strength-reduction
passes.profitability: applies to affine index/address expressions (division/remainder by constants, repeated index work) with equivalent integer/index behavior and the declared floating policy

passes.name: licm
passes.profitability: hoists invariant pure expressions only; masked or trapping accesses are never hoisted; zero-trip loop safety preserved

passes.name: mir-licm
passes.profitability: hoists loop-invariant scalar and sconst rematerializations out of MIR natural loops; only speculatable non-trapping integer/scalar operations move (RISC-V integer add/mul/div do not trap); memory accesses are never hoisted; the same correctness obligation as the TIR passes: the full-input regression must pass with the pass enabled

passes.name: mir-strength-reduction
passes.profitability: rewrites affine induction variables on back-edges (i = i + c, counted-loop bounds known) into block-parameter pointer recursions (p += S), replacing per-iteration base + i*S address multiply trees with equivalent addressing; the induction variable stays maintained when it has uses besides the address

passes.name: mir-loop-predicate
passes.profitability: resolves the per-iteration slt+bne predicate of counted loops whose trip count is known at the loop head (one test per loop instead of one per iteration, zero-trip safety preserved by the rotated guard)

passes.name: mir-vsetvli-hoist
passes.profitability: hoists a vsetvli whose (SEW, LMUL, vl) region is invariant across a loop body and unopposed by any region-switching operation inside it; region consistency is a MIR verifier invariant and the pass models the region state per program point
